items.source_en:
Why Planets Fall

Not every fallen world bears the scars of orbital bombardment. Many collapsed quietly, their skylines intact and their governments still issuing statements long after systems had begun to fail. Early signs were often dismissed as temporary setbacks: trade deficits explained away as market cycles, infrastructure decay postponed with emergency funding, environmental damage reframed as acceptable loss. By the time consequences became visible, responsibility had already diffused beyond accountability.

Debt proved especially effective at hollowing out planetary autonomy. As repayments grew, public services thinned, maintenance was deferred, and oversight shifted from local authority to distant creditors. Corruption followed predictably, not always through overt criminality, but through convenience and complacency. Environmental neglect compounded these failures, turning manageable stress into irreversible decline. When collapse finally arrived, it required no fleets and no declarations, only time.

[This holobook analyzes the gradual failures of multiple galactic worlds, demonstrating how economic dependence, administrative erosion, and environmental disregard can dismantle a planet more thoroughly than war.]
items.legacy_ko:
행성이 몰락하는 이유

모든 몰락한 세계가 궤도 폭격의 상처를 입은 것은 아닙니다. 많은 행성이 시스템이 붕괴하기 시작한 후에도 스카이라인은 그대로 유지되고 정부는 성명을 발표하며 조용히 무너졌습니다. 초기 징후는 종종 일시적인 좌절로 치부되었습니다. 무역 적자는 시장 주기로 설명되었고, 인프라 노후화는 긴급 자금으로 미뤄졌으며, 환경 피해는 감수할 수 있는 손실로 재정의되었습니다. 결과가 가시화되었을 때, 책임은 이미 설명할 수 없는 수준으로 확산된 뒤였습니다.

부채는 행성의 자치권을 갉아먹는 데 특히 효과적이었습니다. 상환액이 늘어남에 따라 공공 서비스는 축소되고, 유지 보수는 지연되었으며, 감독 권한은 지방 당국에서 먼 채권자들에게 넘어갔습니다. 부패는 뻔한 수순으로 뒤따랐는데, 항상 노골적인 범죄를 통해서가 아니라 편의와 안일함을 통해 이루어졌습니다. 환경 방치는 이러한 실패를 가중시켜 관리 가능한 스트레스를 돌이킬 수 없는 쇠퇴로 바꾸었습니다. 마침내 붕괴가 닥쳤을 때, 함대나 선언은 필요 없었습니다. 오직 시간만이 필요했을 뿐입니다.

[이 홀로북은 경제적 의존성, 행정적 침식, 환경적 무시가 어떻게 전쟁보다 더 철저하게 행성을 해체할 수 있는지 보여주며, 여러 은하계 세계의 점진적인 실패를 분석합니다.]

locations.vanilla_source_en:
Charity in a Godless Universe

Amelia Sang

Part I:

Atheism was just the first step, for me.

I was raised in a world of right and wrong. I walked among chosen people. Each night, my family would gather and pray for the sinners in our lives to find salvation.

I can't tell you exactly when I stopped believing in these things. Like many who lose their faith, for me the cracks formed slowly over time: an illogical verse here, an unanswered question there. One day, you realize you're working hard to hold onto something false. You don't want to lose your community, or your connection to your family. But sometimes, maybe things that don't make sense are just wrong.

The details of my awakening aren't important, but what came next is. I never expected that losing my faith would begin a profound new chapter in my life: a time of deep compassion and charity, as a member of the Enlightened.

items.source_en:
The Galactic Empire requires the services of capable operatives willing to assist in matters of personnel recovery and accountability. The ISB has received credible reports of individuals that have failed to maintain their obligations to the Imperial order. Their truancy has created administrative discrepancies which must be resolved.

Applicants should possess discretion, investigative skill, and the ability to operate without drawing undue attention. Previous experience in enforcement, bounty work, or private security is required.

Payment will be rendered upon confirmation of findings.

Interested parties are to report in person to ISB Agent Brym, Coruscant Central Bureau, Sublevel 12, Wing C. Proof of registration and chain code verification required.
